capabilities: Insert today's verse with note and article link
Insert a verse for a chosen feeling
Insert occasion prayers with pray time
Style inserts as callouts or quotes
extras: Inserted links carry utm_source=obsidian so Christian Pure can count visits; today's verse and prayer are cached for an hour. No account, note content or personal data is sent. Install by copying release files into .obsidian/plugins/christian-pure/.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in devotional content, so users must leave the app to copy a verse or prayer into a note.

relations.evidence: This plugin connects to christianpure.com to fetch the verse and prayer text when you run a command.

summary: Devotional content plugin that inserts daily Bible verses, mood-matched verses, and occasion prayers from Christian Pure into notes.
